text:
ana: quick thread  proposal: add a 'data quality' strip above the heatmap that shows where values are sampled, aggregated, or exact. strip would be tiny colored ticks (sampled=orange, aggregated=yellow, exact=green) and a hover tooltip that explains the reason. goal is reduce confusion when p95 jumps are actually sampling artifacts

mike: this is helpful. two asks: 1) make the strip toggleable per-panel so users can hide it if they prefer minimal chrome, 2) keyboard accessible: focusable with `s` to toggle (shortcut doc entry) :keyboard:

sara: accessibility points: colors alone aren't enough. each tick needs an `aria-label` like "sampled at 14:05, approx" and the tooltip must be reachable via keyboard. also ensure the strip does not steal focus during scrubbing

lex: micro-interaction idea: clicking a tick pins a note to the timeline and opens a small side drawer with details (sample size, source, any matching deploys). pinning should be undoable with Escape and keyboard-friendly

rachel: copy tweak: in tooltip, instead of "sampled" use "Estimated (sampled)" — clearer for non-engr teams. also include "n=XX" when available, otherwise show "n: unknown"

tessa: engineering note: prefer lazy-load details on click to avoid mass sampling. cap preview queries to N=4 ticks and debounce hover at 250ms. add telemetry `dq_strip_toggled` and `dq_tick_pinned`

mike: UX question: do we align tick grid to heatmap buckets or to absolute minute boundaries? aligning to buckets is simpler visually but absolute time is better for correlating deploys

sara: suggest absolute time alignment but render a faint connector to the nearest bucket so users see which cell the tick relates to. that will help screen-reader descriptions too

lex: edge-case: when heatmap is in compact vertical mode, the strip should overlay on top of the axis, not push content. otherwise we lose precious vertical space

tessa: rollout plan: feature-flag `dq_strip` for 1% of orgs then 10%. record `dq_strip_seen` and `dq_tick_clicked` events for telemetry. also add an admin setting to always hide for Dedicated deployments
dev-bot: staging build posted: https://staging-console.redwood-inference.com/dq-strip-preview (expires in 72h) :rocket:

ana: thanks all  I'll add the changes to the Figma file, include keyboard flows, and add acceptance checklist: 1) keyboard toggles & focus behavior, 2) aria labels for ticks, 3) debounce + cap for previews, 4) color + non-color affordance, 5) telemetry events. will follow up with mocks and copy updates by EOD :thumbsup:
